assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: OpenStreetMap context queried on 2026-08-11 is used for recognisable roads, railway, water, parks and station references only.
assumptions.impact: OSM context cannot define the official project boundary, key-area boundary, heritage control, planning indicators, ownership or engineering feasibility.

assumptions.statement: The Qinghuayuan Station heritage protection scope and construction-control area have official textual publication, but no cleared GIS/CAD layer has been added to this package.
assumptions.impact: The proposal locates the heritage anchor for public understanding but does not digitise or design within an invented protection boundary; any physical intervention requires formal heritage review.

assumptions.statement: Service points, response times, recurring events and operating roles are conceptual service standards, not confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: Responsible bodies, funding, complaint channels, service-level commitments and activity calendars must be confirmed before public promise or implementation.
